			change_communist_cadres_opinion = yes
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = HLS }
				HLS = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_POL.129 days = 1 } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_western_dioceses_open value = 1 days = 90 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_offer_western_dioceses_party = ruling_party }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_western_dioceses_refused
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_POL_western_dioceses
				HLS = {
					add_ideas = COLDWAR_POL_western_dioceses_partner
				}
			}
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}

					add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
